---
title: "How to Handle Analytics+ Subscriptions (AR Guide)"
---

## **Purpose** 

This SOP defines how AR handles Analytics+ subscriptions across their full lifecycle: sign-up, active billing, and cancellation.

Analytics+ is an add-on tier Latchel offers. Property managers must enable it on their account to unlock upgraded reporting, and they subscribe to access those specific reports. To know more about it, you can check [<u>Getting Started with Analytics+</u>](https://help.latchel.com/s/topic/0TO5e000000h9wqGAA/getting-started-with-analytics-plus#getting-started-with-analytics)

## **Overview of AR’s Tasks for Analytics+ Subscription**

**Sign-up**

- Catch the sign-up notification in Slack #accounts-receivable
- Confirm active via Latchel Console or Stripe subscriptions list
- Confirm the sign-up invoice is created in Stripe and paid in real time

**During subscription**

- Manually confirm the unit count for the customer to set the correct rate
- Confirm Analytics+ is included on the Monthly Subscription invoice
- Once payment clears, reconcile it against the Rillet invoice

**Cancellation**

- Catch the cancellation notification in Slack #accounts-receivable
- Confirm the cancellation in Stripe
- Delete the Analytics Dashboard URL in the Latchel Console
- Confirm the customer is removed from the Monthly Subscription invoice going forward

### **When a customer signs up**

The customer contacts their CSM to add the subscription. AR is then notified by a notification in the Slack #accounts-receivable channel.

On receiving the notification, confirm the subscription is active using either of these two checks:

1. **Latchel Console -** Open the property manager profile, go to Miscellaneous Settings, and find the Analytics Dashboard URL tab. If a URL is present, the Analytics subscription is active for that customer.

See sample snippet below:

2. **Stripe -** Go to the Billing tab, click the arrow, choose Subscriptions, click Price, and select Analytics + from the dropdown. Click Apply to list every customer with an Analytics+ subscription. Set the filter to All to view active, canceled, and other statuses. 

Viewing Analytics+ Subscriptions in Stripe : 

[<u>https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EnxJo1STfeIiCcPwYDwpWlXX_Ya12q-5/view?usp=drive_link</u>](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EnxJo1STfeIiCcPwYDwpWlXX_Ya12q-5/view?usp=drive_link)<br />

As soon as the customer signs up, an invoice is created in Stripe. It should be paid in real time by the customer so they can start using the subscription.<br />

_Important: It is important to make sure the [<u>Analytics+  Customer Tracker</u>](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17iGZWhiLdFoZ-UbGhv1wILuxGoxxGSD3FozAm9vqjKY/edit?gid=0#gid=0) is updated whenever a customer signs up and cancels _

### **During an active subscription**

While the subscription stays active, Stripe creates a recurring invoice every month after sign-up, and monthly thereafter until the subscription is cancelled. Stripe automatically charges the payment method associated with the account.

Because Stripe is connected to Rillet, every invoice created in Stripe also creates a matching invoice in Rillet. Once the payment clears, AR reconciles the received payment against the Rillet invoice.<br />

**Recent change:** Analytics+ is no longer billed on a separate invoice. It is now added to the customer's Monthly Subscription invoice alongside maintenance and other Latchel products. This makes payment collection easier and prevents an Analytics+ invoice from being left unpaid after a customer cancels. Under this model, AR must manually confirm the units for each customer, the same way other product billing works, to determine the correct rate to apply.

#### **Rate & pricing**

The rate is tiered by total quantity of units. Confirm the unit count per customer before applying the rate.

| **Total quantity** | **Unit price** | **Flat Amount** |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 1 to 333 | \$0.00 | \$100.00 |
| 334 or more | \$0.30 | — |

### **When a customer cancels**

When a customer stops the subscription, a notification is flagged in the #accounts-receivable channel, the same as at sign-up.

On receiving it, AR:

1. Confirms the cancellation in Stripe.
2. Removes the customer's report access by deleting the Analytics Dashboard URL in the property manager profile in the Latchel Console. Removing the URL cuts off access to the reports.
3. Updates the [<u>Analytics+  Customer Tracker</u>](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17iGZWhiLdFoZ-UbGhv1wILuxGoxxGSD3FozAm9vqjKY/edit?gid=0#gid=0).
4. Ensures the customer is no longer billed for the subscription and is removed from their Monthly Subscription invoice going forward.
